data.codeDesc: The following purchase order is not in a pending shipment status: {0}
data.solution: 检查采购单状态，确保都是待发货状态

data.codeDesc: The operated order {} does not belong to the store or its associated business group, and the current store does not have permission to operate it. Please go to the 'Business Group Management' page to apply to join the business group“
data.solution: 请到'商群管理'页面申请加入商群

data.codeDesc: The length of the license plate number exceeds 16 digits. Please make the correct changes and resubmit
data.solution: 请检查入参中的车牌号，确保其长度不超过16位

data.codeDesc: {0} These purchase orders are already in other self delivery orders, please check!
data.solution: 检查入参中的采购单号，剔除已经创建过自寄单的采购单号

data.codeDesc: The ordered store has not joined the business group and does not support cross store packaging. Please apply to join the business group on the 'Business Group Management' page and then re package
data.solution: 请到'商群管理'页面申请加入商群

data.codeDesc: The quantity of PO query is incorrect
data.solution: 检查入参中的采购单，剔除【已取消】状态的采购单，
检查入参中的自送预约时间错误

data.codeDesc: The warehouse CODE on the receipt is inconsistent and cannot be merged for self shipment
The GFS system of the logistics department returned an error
The following documents are not in a pending shipment status and cannot be shipped: {}
data.solution: 检查入参中的单据，剔除不是【待发货】状态的单据，

data.codeDesc: query supplier failed, please try later
Failed to obtain associated consign order
data.solution: 检查入参中的采购单，剔除【已取消】状态的发货单，

data.codeDesc: Failed to update the extension fields of the warehouse receipt
The estimated volume of the goods exceeds the upper limit allowed by the system. Please revise it correctly and resubmit
data.solution: 检查入参中的预估货物体积
系统异常，请重试或者联系供应链物流协同域
